notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three tapped lands.
description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Mana Geyser.
Resolve the copy of Mana Geyser, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Rootha from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
If opponents control four or more tapped lands, this combo nets infinite red mana.
